papers.title_en: Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Mean-Field Games with Average Reward
papers.authors: Şevket Kaan Alkır, Naci Saldı, Berkay Anahtarcı, Can Deha Karıksız
papers.evidence: 针对平均奖励无穷时域平均场博弈的逆强化学习，直接处理长时域奖励
papers.tldr: 在离散时间无限时域平均场博弈中，专家演示来自未知奖励的平稳均衡，逆强化学习需从演示中恢复奖励函数。本研究采用最大因果熵原则，在统一的占用测度框架下处理线性与RKHS两类奖励。对于线性奖励，给出凸对偶重构和常步长梯度下降；对于RKHS奖励，借助次要化构造压缩映射，解决软贝尔曼方程无折扣因子的挑战，并建立得分函数的可微性与平滑性。数值实验验证了算法有效性，为无折扣平均奖励平均场逆强化学习提供了系统解法。
papers.abstract_en: We study inverse reinforcement learning for discrete-time, infinite-horizon mean-field games (MFGs) under an average-reward criterion. Expert demonstrations are assumed to arise from a stationary mean-field equilibrium under an unknown reward, and the goal is to recover a policy explaining the observed behaviour via the maximum causal entropy principle. We formulate the inverse problem by enforcing consistency with the expert mean-field term and long-run feature expectations, treating two reward classes within a unified occupation-measure framework. For finite-dimensional linear rewards, we give a convex dual reformulation with an explicit log-partition objective, and prove smoothness and curvature properties justifying constant-step-size gradient descent. For infinite-dimensional RKHS rewards, we develop a Lagrangian relaxation whose inner-maximising policy is characterised by a soft Bellman equation. The main obstacle is the absence of a discount-factor contraction. We resolve this by introducing a minorisation-based sub-stochastic kernel that yields a strict contraction of the soft Bellman operator. We establish Fréchet differentiability and Lipschitz smoothness of the log-likelihood score, leading to a gradient ascent algorithm with convergence guarantees. Two numerical examples, a malware-spread MFG and an RKHS-based consumer-choice model, show that the recovered policies closely match expert behaviour.

papers.authors: Aditya Oberai, Seohong Park, Sergey Levine
papers.evidence: 通过流匹配和偏差-方差缩减缓解异策略强化学习中的长时域问题
papers.tldr: 迭代生成建模（如流匹配）为离线强化学习提供了强大行为建模工具，但现有流基方法常依赖时间反向传播，训练效率受限。本文提出Reversal Q-learning（RQL），通过反转流生成虚拟在线轨迹并结合偏-方差缩减，在扩展MDP框架下实现高效离策略流策略训练。实验表明，RQL在50个机器人任务中平均性能超越现有流基离线RL算法，且无需反向传播，展现了生成模型与离线RL协同的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Iterative generative modeling techniques, such as flow matching, provide powerful tools to model complex behaviors for effective offline reinforcement learning (RL). In this work, we propose a new off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy based on prior data. Our idea starts from the "expanded" Markov decision process (MDP) framework, which treats individual flow refinement steps as separate actions in an MDP. To enable off-policy RL within this framework, we apply two techniques: we generate virtual on-policy trajectories (by "reversing" flows) to make this framework compatible with prior data, and we apply a bias-and-variance reduction technique to mitigate the curse of horizon in off-policy RL. We call the resulting algorithm Reversal Q-learning (RQL). RQL has several advantages over previous flow-based RL methods: it does not suffer from backpropagation through time, makes better use of the learned value function, and directly trains the full, expressive flow policy. Through our experiments on 50 challenging simulated robotic tasks, we show that RQL leads to the best average offline RL performance compared to state-of-the-art flow-based offline RL algorithms.

papers.title_en: When Does Trajectory-Level Supervision Permit Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning?
papers.evidence: 研究离线RL中从轨迹级结果进行长时程奖励分配
papers.tldr: 离线强化学习通常需过程级奖励，但多数数据集仅有轨迹级结果标签。论文提出悲观actor-critic算法OPAC，从轨迹级标签学习潜在奖励，并证明其高概率保证及匹配下界。进一步扩展至偏好反馈与广义结果监督，识别可处理条件，揭示缺失过程级奖励的根本障碍，为结果级离线RL提供理论界定。
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning is typically analyzed under process-level reward supervision, yet many sequential decision datasets   record only trajectory-level outcomes. We develop a statistical theory for offline policy optimization from such outcome-level   supervision. We first study the canonical setting where the target remains the expected cumulative reward, but each offline trajectory   provides only a scalar label whose conditional mean is the cumulative return. We propose OPAC, a pessimistic actor-critic algorithm   that learns a latent reward model and optimizes a policy from trajectory-level labels. We prove a high-probability guarantee of order   $\widetilde O(H^2\sqrt{C_{sa}(π^\star)/n})$ and a matching lower bound, characterizing the sharp statistical cost of replacing   process-level rewards with one trajectory-level label. We then extend the principle to preference-based feedback, preserving the   leading horizon and concentrability dependence up to preference-model constants. Finally, we study generalized outcome-based offline   RL, where both the supervision and the objective are trajectory-level quantities induced by a nonlinear aggregation of latent per-step   rewards. This problem is not learnable in general: for all-success objectives, any offline learner may require $Ω(2^H)$   trajectories even with deterministic transitions and constant concentrability. We then identify a tractable regime through two   structural coefficients, $κ_μ(σ)$ and $χ_μ(σ)$, capturing information loss in outcome aggregation and   generalized Bellman updates, under which generalized OPAC achieves polynomial sample complexity. Together, our results delineate when   outcome-level supervision enables sample-efficient offline control and when missing process-level rewards create fundamental   statistical barriers.

papers.title_en: R2D-RL: A RoboCup 2D Soccer Environment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Haobin Qin, Baofeng Zhang, Hidehisa Akiyama, Keisuke Fujii
papers.evidence: 支持混合参数化动作空间的强化学习环境
papers.tldr: 机器人足球环境兼具部分观测、稀疏奖励和长视域战术协作等挑战，是多智能体强化学习的理想测试床。现有RoboCup 2D仿真平台采用竞赛导向的服务器-客户端架构，难以直接对接现代Python MARL工作流。为此提出R2D-RL，通过共享内存同步将RCSS2D与HELIOS客户端接入Python接口，支持全场/场景训练、离散与混合动作空间、EPV奖励塑形及并行执行。在11v11全场等基准上给出了基线结果，为合作与对抗MARL研究提供一站式标准化平台。
papers.abstract_en: Robot soccer is a challenging testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning because it combines partial observability, cooperative and adversarial interaction, sparse rewards, and long-horizon tactical behavior. RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation (RCSS2D) provides a mature robot-soccer platform, but its competition-oriented server-client architecture is difficult to use directly with modern Python-based MARL workflows. We introduce R2D-RL, a reinforcement learning environment that connects RCSS2D and HELIOS-based player clients to a Python MARL interface through shared-memory communication and cycle-level synchronization. R2D-RL supports full-field and scenario-based training with configurable opponents, Base discrete and Hybrid parameterized action spaces, action masks, expected possession value (EPV)-based reward shaping, and parallel execution. We provide front-goal scenarios and an 11-vs-11 full-field benchmark, together with baseline results.

papers.title_en: TetraRL: A Self-Adaptive Runtime for On-Device Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems
papers.authors: Zexin Li, Soheil Shirvani, Cong Liu
papers.evidence: 面向无人机的设备端深度强化学习运行时，支持巡检任务中的实时自主决策
papers.tldr: 为解决自主机器人（包括无人机）上设备端深度强化学习面临的实时性、任务奖励、内存和能耗多目标平衡难题，提出自适应运行时TetraRL。该框架在不牺牲可靠性前提下在线调整资源分配，实验表明其能有效提升嵌入式DRL性能，为无人机巡检等需要机载学习的任务提供了重要的系统支持。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robotic systems, including autonomous vehicles, drones, and mobile robots, increasingly rely on on-device Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to adapt to dynamic environments. Unlike cloud-based solutions, embedded DRL must perform training and inference directly on resource-constrained hardware while maintaining timely decision-making. This creates a fundamental challenge: balancing four tightly coupled objectives, real-time performance, task reward, memory utilization, and energy consumption. Optimizing these objectives independently often leads to suboptimal behavior, while conventional multi-objective methods may violate resource constraints and compromise reliability.   This paper presents TetraRL, a self-adaptive runtime framework for tetra-objective on-device DRL. TetraRL formulates embedded DRL as a unified optimization problem over real-time, reward, RAM, and reserve (energy) objectives, and employs a preference-conditioned reinforcement learning controller to dynamically navigate the resulting trade-off space. The framework integrates a unified resource-management abstraction, hardware-aware DVFS control, and a runtime Override Layer for robust constraint enforcement. We implement TetraRL on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and Orin Nano platforms and evaluate it across diverse DRL environments. Results show that TetraRL effectively balances all four objectives, achieves competitive trade-offs under varying runtime preferences, and incurs negligible overhead. Moreover, a single trained policy can support runtime-switchable optimization goals, providing a practical foundation for resource-aware and self-adaptive on-device DRL.

papers.title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Highway Driving: A Unified Framework for Safety and Efficiency
papers.authors: Chufei Yan, Zhihao Cui, Yiyan Lv, Taojie Chen, Ning Bian, Yulei Wang
papers.evidence: 使用奖励机器将阶段性目标编码为奖励，实现长时域奖励分配
papers.tldr: 深度强化学习用于自动驾驶面临训练安全与部署效率难以兼顾的挑战。本文提出MoE-RM-SRL框架，融合安全距离、奖励机与专家混合，部署时通过规则感知奖励编码交规与阶段目标，训练时以稀疏门控激活最少车道保持与变道专家。在CARLA仿真中，该方法在随机双车道场景下安全性和效率均显著超越基线，并可自然扩展至多车道及匝道合流与驶出任务。
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) offers a compelling route to decision-making for advanced autonomous vehicles (AVs), yet its trial-and-error nature makes it difficult to guarantee safety during training and to achieve both safety and efficiency at deployment. We propose a unified safe reinforcement learning (SRL) framework that integrates safe distance (SD), reward machines (RM), and mixture-of-experts (MoE), termed MoE-RM-SRL. For deployment, SD and RM jointly shape a rule-aware reward that encodes highway traffic regulations and stage-wise objectives, enabling safe and reliable behavior without sacrificing efficiency. For training, we introduce a sparsely gated MoE layer comprising up to 11 deep Q-networks (DQNs); an SD-based gating rule activates a minimal set of experts for lane-keeping and lane-changing, mitigating the instability, discontinuities, and impulsive transients commonly induced by switching between heterogeneous controllers (e.g., MPC/rule-based modules and learned policies). We implement the proposed architecture in CARLA and integrate it with a 6-DoF driver-in-the-loop virtual-reality (DiL-VR) platform. Experiments in stochastic two-lane traffic show that MoE-RM-SRL substantially improves safety and efficiency over state-of-the-art baselines, and the framework naturally extends to multi-lane driving as well as on-ramp merging and exiting scenarios.

papers.title_en: TRIDENT: Breaking the Hybrid-Safety-Physics Coupling for Provably Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Zijie Meng, Ziwei Li, Yufei Liu, Zhiyu Li, Jiyuan Liu, Wenhua Nie, Bingcai Wei, Miao Zhang
papers.evidence: 处理强化学习中的混合离散-连续动作空间，并考虑安全约束，与混合动作空间需求相关
papers.tldr: 多智能体强化学习在混合离散-连续动作、硬安全约束和物理驱动动态下形成三向耦合偏差，使得简单模块组合失效，难以实现安全协调。TRIDENT框架独创性地协同设计三组件：Richardson-Romberg梯度校正将Gumbel-Softmax偏差从O(τ)降至O(τ²)，Lyapunov约束的顺序信任域更新保证每步可行，以及物理信息残差critic分解值函数。在无人机边缘计算、自主交叉口管理等任务上，TRIDENT训练违反相比MADDPG降低95.5%、相比MACPO降低76.3%，奖励比最强无约束基线提升13.5%。该框架首次实现耦合偏差的定向消除，并提供了收敛到约束纳什均衡的理论保证，为安全关键多智能体系统铺平道路。
papers.abstract_en: Safe coordination in networked cyber-physical systems forces learning algorithms to simultaneously handle hybrid discrete-continuous actions, hard training-time safety constraints, and physics-governed dynamics. We show that these three features form a directed cycle of biases that defeats any naive composition of off-the-shelf modules, and formalize this as a three-way coupling lemma. We then introduce TRIDENT, the first MARL framework whose three components are co-designed to cancel each leak: a Richardson-Romberg gradient correction reducing Gumbel-Softmax bias from O(tau) to O(tau^2), a Lyapunov-constrained sequential trust-region update enforcing per-iterate feasibility, and a physics-informed residual critic that decomposes value rather than reward. We prove an O~(1/sqrt(K)) convergence rate to a constrained Nash equilibrium and an O(sqrt(K)) cumulative-violation bound. On multi-UAV mobile-edge computing, autonomous intersection management, and a hybrid SMAC variant, TRIDENT cuts training-time violations by 95.5% over MADDPG and 76.3% over MACPO, while improving reward by 13.5% over the strongest unconstrained baseline.

papers.title_en: Learning to Adapt: Representation-Based Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Task Skill Transfer
papers.authors: Aryan Naveen, Haitong Ma, Haldun Balim, Na Li
papers.evidence: 将强化学习用于四旋翼轨迹跟踪，可应用于无人机巡检任务
papers.tldr: 强化学习在多任务场景下样本效率低且泛化能力不足，制约复杂控制策略的应用。本文提出RepMT-SAC框架，通过谱MDP分解抽取可迁移动力学，将价值函数建模为任务无关核心与轻量任务特定调整两部分。在四旋翼轨迹跟随任务中，该方法实现分布内任务的零样本高性能和分布外任务的快速少样本适应，性能最高超出基线30%。该工作为高效多任务技能迁移提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in learning complex control policies, yet its applicability remains limited due to sample inefficiency and poor generalization across tasks. In this work, we propose RepMT-SAC, a framework for multi-task RL that enables efficient knowledge sharing and robust transfer to new tasks. RepMT-SAC uses spectral MDP decomposition to capture transferable dynamics, structuring the value function into a task-agnostic core with a minimal task-specific adjustment. This design allows for strong zero-shot performance on in-distribution tasks and rapid few-shot adaptation to out-of-distribution tasks. We evaluate RepMT-SAC on quadcopter trajectory-following tasks across in-distribution and out-of-distribution contexts, demonstrating that it outperforms baselines by up to 30%.
